audit.why: 6/10 difficulty and an EVEN tag sit correctly against 52.44% over 1640 games — Sion is marginally favoured through levels 2-3 and the lane flattens after that.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row was scored to Sion in both layers, while spikes[3] and whys[6] on the same page describe a mutual frontline brawl with no owner, and the packet chart lists Skill.
audit.why: Volibear's carry threat is rated 7/10 and both champions convert into frontline juggernauts; nothing in either kit gives Sion the two-item edge the chart claimed.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] set to Skill; the 5/10 rating already matches an even row and is unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two kit facts were wrong. Sky Splitter was described as granting damage reduction inside the zone — Riot's text says it grants Volibear a SHIELD if he is inside the blast radius. Stormbringer was described as a 'massive HP shield' worth '1000 free HP' — Riot's text says he gains bonus Health, which is a different thing (it does not decay and it is not consumed like a shield), and the 1000 figure is not in the data at all.
audit.why: The page told the user to wait for a shield to expire before brawling. Bonus health does not expire that way, so the advice sent him into a worse fight than the one he was avoiding.
audit.corrected: Sky Splitter rewritten as a 16s slow-plus-shield; Stormbringer rewritten as bonus health with the 160s rank-1 cooldown as the real punish window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and it is accurate — not one number appeared in the matchup.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1, Sky Splitter is a flat 16s and Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1. Those three numbers are the entire punish schedule of this lane.
audit.corrected: All three written into whys[3], whys[4], spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash is an auto-attack reset and the page never said so — it described the dash but not the tell.
audit.why: The wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back; players who watch for the ability animation react one auto too late.

edits.before: His E Sky Splitter slows and gives him damage reduction inside — respect the zone and angle your Q charge from outside it so he can't pick the trade on his terms.
edits.after: Sky Splitter is a flat 16s cooldown that slows you and shields him only if he stands in the blast — angle your Q charge from outside it and he must pick slow or shield.

edits.before: His Stormbringer disables your turret and pops a huge HP shield — wait out the shield before brawling; your charged Q stun wastes its knockup against 1000 free HP.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables your turret and grants him bonus health — not a shield, so it does not tick away. Brawl once the 160s ultimate is spent, never under a dead tower.

edits.before: His Stormbringer disables your turret and gives him a massive HP shield — respect the dive window and keep your charged Q ready to peel his Q-stun if he charges in.
edits.after: Stormbringer grants him bonus health and shuts your turret off for the dive — hold charged Q for Thundering Smash, a 12s cooldown, and release as his dash commits.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are even ground — his E Sky Splitter slow is annoying for charging your Q since he picks the engagement angle, and the Sky Splitter damage reduction means he takes less while standing in it. Respect that window and angle your Q charge from outside the lightning zone. At Level 6 his Stormbringer is the real danger: it gives him a massive HP shield and kills your tower for a few seconds, making a dive unexpectedly lethal. If he Rs into your turret, stay back, let the shield expire, and only brawl after it drops — your charged Q stun is worth nothing against a Voli with 1000 HP of free shield absorbing it.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even ground — his E Sky Splitter slow is annoying for charging your Q since he picks the engagement angle, and standing inside the blast radius shields him while he does it. Respect that 16s window and angle your Q charge from outside the lightning. At Level 6 his Stormbringer is the real danger: it grants him bonus health and kills your tower for a few seconds, making a dive unexpectedly lethal. If he Rs onto your turret, stay back and brawl only once the ultimate is spent — at 160 seconds a wasted Stormbringer hands you the next three minutes of the lane.

edits.before: Q-dash into melee range to stun you, then immediately W-bite to double-apply on-hit and heal off the proc
edits.after: Open with the Thundering Smash auto-reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast — then double W-bite to heal

notes: The packet's suspectNames are both FALSE POSITIVES: 'Stormbringer' is the correct Riot name for Volibear's R, and the flagged strings ('His Stormbringer', 'Hit Stormbringer') only differ from the lookup key by the preceding word. No ability name needed renaming in this matchup. Sion Q's listed range of 10000 is a data artifact and was not used.
